page.overview:
Who is Aedla?

Aedla was a squire of Lady Diassa Kwynn, paladin of (presumably) the Lawbearer. At some point during their squireship, Kwynn explained to them how, in her youth, she had discovered the extent and severity of the dangers in the world, and warned Aedla to stay close to her, be safe, and to bury her curiosity. Aedla has neither appeared nor been mentioned on Critical Role.
